# DEV Community

> A vibrant community platform for software developers to share knowledge, discuss technologies, and advance their careers through articles, tutorials, and peer engagement.

DEV Community is a collaborative space where developers of all levels share articles, tutorials, and career advice across programming languages, frameworks, and emerging technologies like AI. The platform emphasizes open-source contributions, best practices, and community-driven learning.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- React
- Python
- Web Development
- DevOps
- Open Source
- Artificial Intelligence
- Security
- TypeScript
- Career Development
- Tutorials
- Frontend Development
- Community Discussion
- Developer Tools
- C#

## Core Platform

- [DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.freetls.fastly.net): DEV Community homepage for software development discussion and career management
- [Welcome! - DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.freetls.fastly.net/enter): DEV Community login and signup page with social authentication options

## Programming Languages & Frameworks

- [JavaScript - DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.freetls.fastly.net/t/javascript): JavaScript tutorials and framework discussions on DEV Community
- [React - DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.freetls.fastly.net/t/react): React tutorials and frontend development content on DEV
- [Python - DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.freetls.fastly.net/t/python): Python programming tutorials and AI/ML content on DEV

## Learning & Development

- [Beginners - DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.freetls.fastly.net/t/beginners): Beginner-friendly guides and getting started content on DEV

- [Programming - DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.freetls.fastly.net/t/programming): Programming articles and tutorials on DEV Community
